text:
maria: quick proposal — introduce a lightweight `route_group_id` to canonicalize related routes (ui, api, sdk variants). plan is to: add nullable column to console_metrics, start dual-write from API, backfill historical rows to route_group for the last 90d, and then switch queries/dashboards over. thoughts?

adeep: curious about cardinality — will route_group reduce or increase index size? if many routes map 1:1 then not much gain. we need migration perf numbers. also how do we resolve conflicts for old rows w/ multiple tags? :thinking:

jun: for backfill I'd recommend a staged approach: (1) compute mapping table route->route_group using latest tagging, (2) create a MV for console_metrics joined to mapping, (3) run incremental updates writing to console_metrics.route_group_id for ranges. sample SQL for a chunked backfill:```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE console_metrics cm
SET route_group_id = m.route_group_id
FROM mapping m
WHERE cm.route_id = m.route_id
  AND cm.route_group_id IS NULL
  AND cm.event_ts BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-07';
COMMIT;
```
Chunk by week, verify query counts, then move window forward.

sasha: from console side — dashboards rely on route_id and route_label. once dual-write enabled we'll need a feature-flagged UI toggle to source by route_group_id so customers don't see drift mid-rollout. also add a fallback that if route_group_id IS NULL we synthesize using tags so widgets don't break.

adeep: dual-write safety: prefer write-first-to-new-service then replicate back to old column (idempotent). we should add a validation job that compares counts per-day per-route between old and new keys for a sample tenant set before cutover.

ops: incident note — backfills frequently spike replication lag. suggest throttling with a token-bucket and a rolling schedule (low-traffic hours). also add a runaway detector that aborts if replication lag > 60s.

ingest-bot: schema-check: added column console_metrics.route_group_id nullable BIGINT — migration lint OK.

jun: one more: to keep queries fast, create a composite index on (route_group_id, event_ts) and a small materialized view for top-k route_groups per-tenant updated nightly. this avoids heavy group-by on the raw table.

sasha: agree. and for the rollout UX let's add a migration-mode label in the console that shows whether a dashboard is reading from route_id or route_group_id, with a preview. small UX piece but saves trouble.

maria: action items: (1) adeep/jun to draft chunked backfill runbook + throttling knobs — due EOD Tue, (2) sasha to prototype UI toggle + fallback, (3) infra/ops to add lag monitor + abort hook. I'll create a short RFC and link here. :thumbsup: 

adeep: ack — i'll add the validation job pseudocode in the RFC.

maria: thanks — will ping once RFC link is up: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/route-group-migration (draft)
